about: The assignment table: which skills each kind of work gets. A task fits a row when one criterion of the row holds (OR). A criterion with a rule is decided by code from the task's facts; every other criterion is a question that rex_assign asks the decision agent, who answers yes or no with a reason. placement: read-first = each step of the task needs the row; open-when = the task reaches it in one case; ask = a second question decides. files are sibling files of a skill: always open-when, with their case. cap = most read-first skills of one task; the rest move to open-when by priority (a lower number stays first). A repo changes rows with .rex/assign.json: rows of the same id replace these, new ids are added, ids under remove are dropped.
